source_user: Choose between tensor and pipeline parallelism for a latency-sensitive multi-GPU service. State the assumptions needed. Scenario variant 268: include an explicit falsifiable hypothesis and a controlled experiment.
source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: compare per-GPU memory, communication topology, layer partitioning, batch and microbatch behavior, synchronization, latency target, and failure/reconfiguration costs.
corrected_answer: For scenario variant 268, do not select tensor parallelism (TP) or pipeline parallelism (PP) from the prompt alone. Assume the model graph, parameter/activation sizes, precision, GPU count/type and usable HBM (GiB), interconnect topology and measured bandwidth/latency, runtime versions, clock/power state, request-length and arrival distributions, concurrency, batching policy, and latency/throughput/error/quality/availability SLO thresholds are available; distinguish measured facts from estimates. Enumerate topology-compatible TP degrees and balanced PP stage partitions, including placement and reconfiguration options. Reject candidates lacking positive per-GPU memory headroom, communication feasibility, correctness, or a safe rollback path. Hypothesis: under identical hardware, software, workload mix, arrival rate, precision, clocks, concurrency, and batching, the feasible configuration with lower held-out p99 end-to-end latency while meeting every SLO gate will outperform the other; this is falsified if its held-out p99 is not lower or any gate fails. Warm up, randomize paired trials, tune on a disjoint sample, and evaluate on held-out requests. Measure per-GPU HBM/headroom, compute, TP collective time and PP activation-transfer time, synchronization waits, stage imbalance, pipeline bubbles, queueing, throughput, TTFT, TPOT, p50/p95/p99 latency, errors, output quality, and reconfiguration/recovery time, always with units, sample counts, and uncertainty. Stratify by prompt length and load; control placement, software, thermal state, retries, interference, and workload drift, and report confidence intervals. For this {category.lower()} case, pre-register the decision rule and thresholds before evaluation. Run failure or reconfiguration tests only in an authorized isolated environment. Canary the winner behind health, memory, error, quality, availability, and latency gates; abort and restore the last known-good configuration on any breach, unsafe memory pressure, failed health check, or regression, preserving logs and recovery evidence.
